# Official GSAP skills

Source: https://github.com/greensock/gsap-skills

Pinned revision: `aed9cfd3277740755f6bfc1155c7aa645403b760`

Copyright (c) 2026 GreenSock. Distributed under the included MIT `LICENSE`.

A copy of the same license is included in each GSAP skill directory so standalone installations retain the copyright and permission notice.

The eight `skills/gsap-*/SKILL.md` files are copied without modification. Their source paths and SHA-256 fingerprints, normalized to LF line endings for cross-platform verification, are recorded in `config/upstream-gsap.json`.

To update, review an upstream revision, copy its skill files and license, update the provenance record, and run `pwsh ./scripts/check.ps1`. Keep upstream instructions separate from HalalFrFr's choreography guidance. These are agent instructions, not the GSAP runtime or an MP4 rendering pipeline.
